purpose_en: A seed treatment that protects young roots from fungus and helps beneficial microbes colonise roots and leaves.
purpose_ta: இளம் வேர்களை பூஞ்சையிலிருந்து பாதுகாத்து, நன்மை செய்யும் நுண்ணுயிர்கள் வேர் மற்றும் இலைகளில் பெருக உதவும் விதை நேர்த்தி கரைசல்.

key_points: Ingredients: "5 kg cow dung, 5 litre cow urine, 50 gram lime, 1kg bund soil, 20 litre water"
Hang the cow dung in a cloth in the water for up to 12 hours; soak the lime in water overnight; then squeeze the dung bundle and mix in the soil, urine and lime water
"Add Beejamrit to the seeds of any crop; coat them, mixing by hand; dry them well and use them for sowing."
For legume seeds with thin coats, dip quickly and dry

source_organization: NITI Aayog, Government of India (Natural Farming: NITI Initiative)
